name: ecuc-document-ui-polish
title: ECUC Document-only UI polish and details editing
description: Remove the Tree view and Document line numbers; replace the full-width indent rules with bracket-to-bracket container guides; move parameter value editing into the details panel; add labelled collapse controls, green containers, yellow-italic same-file reference links, a dark-only palette and a subtree/active selection hierarchy; remove the F2 inline hint, the details Source block, and the Copy path/Copy value actions. Preserve selection, reveal, re-scan, validation, accessibility and the Document presentation.
creator: deviousprophet
